data.title: Revolution put end to Union's club-record 15-match unbeaten streak with 2-1 victory - The Washington Post
data.content: # Revolution put end to Union's club-record 15-match unbeaten streak with 2-1 victory. Dor Tugeman and Carles Gil scored goals behind Matt Turner and the New England Revolution ended Philadelphia’s club-record 15-match unbeaten streak with a 2-1 victory over the Union. — Dor Tugeman and Carles Gil scored goals behind Matt Turner and the New England Revolution ended Philadelphia’s club-record 15-match unbeaten streak with a 2-1 victory over the Union on Saturday night. Turner finished with six saves for the Revolution (17-10-4), who moved ahead of Inter Miami in the battle for the second seed in the Eastern Conference.
